1.​Marshall Jobs

      1.1.​ Knight Marshal
            ●​ The knight marshal is in charge at a tournament, both inside and outside the list.
            ●​ There may be more than one Knight Marshal for tournaments like Conference or World
               Cup.
            ●​ A trainee marshal cannot be a Knight Marshal unless it is necessary.
      1.2.​ Field Marshal
            ●​ The marshal inside the list in Buhurt.
            ●​ A trainee marshal cannot be a field marshal unless it is necessary.
      1.3.​ Lines Marshal
            ●​ The marshal outside the list in Buhurt.
            ●​ Acting as counters for Duels, and outrance,

2.​Accreditation Reference Accreditation
                            document
      2.1.​ Trainee - Level 4
           A Trainee Marshal is the first step toward achieving international accreditation as a marshal.
           For further details, please refer to the Marshal Accreditation document.

      2.2.​ Regional - Level 3
           A Regional Marshal is an individual who has gained experience working at multiple events,
           successfully passed the Trainee test, and is now qualified to marshal inside the list.

      2.3.​ Conference - Level 2
           A Conference Marshal is an individual with extensive knowledge of the rules and has worked
           at various events. They have completed their exam, Interview and are on track for
           International accreditation.

      2.4.​ International - Level 1
           An International Marshal is the final level of accreditation, achieved by individuals with
           extensive experience in high-level events and demonstrating exceptional skills and
           knowledge.

3.​Marshal Titles

      3.1.​ Buhurt International Head Marshal
            ●​ Organizer Marshal for the world.
            ●​ Will be selected from one of the Conference Head Marshals.
      3.2.​ Conference Head Marshal
            ●​ Organizer Marshal for Conference.
            ●​ Will be selected from one of the Regional Head Marshals in that Conference.
      3.3.​ Buhurt International Advisor
            ●​ Special nomination for Highly Experienced Marshals that do not hold another title.
            ●​ They advise the Buhurt International Head Marshal.
            ●​ This position will be selected by the Buhurt International Committee.
      3.4.​ Deputy Conference Head Marshal
            ●​ Deputy Organizer Marshal for Conference.
            ●​ Will be selected from one of the Regional Head Marshals in that Conference.
      3.5.​ Regional Head Marshal
            ●​ Organizer Marshal for Region.
               Example: UK Head Marshal. France Head Marshal.

      3.6.​ Senior International Marshal
            ●​ International marshals that are a very high level but are not regional heads or committee
               members.
            ●​ The Buhurt International marshal committee will give this title to a marshal.

5.​Marshal uniforms
                 This section displays all the rules and regulations about uniforms for marshals.

      5.1.​ Knight marshal
            ●​ Knight Marshals wear 14th to 16th century period clothes that are yellow and black
               striped.

      5.2.​ Field marshal and line marshal
            ●​ All accredited marshals who are not Knight Marshals at a tournament wear 14th to 16th
               century period clothes that are yellow.

      5.3.​ Trainee marshal
            ●​ Trainee Marshals wear 14th to 16th century period clothes that are not yellow, with a
               yellow hood.

      5.4.​ Modern events
            ●​ Marshals are allowed to wear a yellow shirt at modern events. Appropriate pants and
               shoes must be worn.
